title: When Interference Graphs Evolve: Doubly Robust Estimation of Dynamic Peer Effects
abstract: arXiv:2608.27187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Peer effects are difficult to estimate when interaction graphs evolve because pre-assignment network history, dynamic peer exposure, and post-assignment network change have distinct causal roles. We introduce a controlled contrast framework that indexes potential outcomes by own treatment, temporally aggregated peer exposure, and a post-assignment evolution summary. Differences between the resulting means define own-treatment, peer-exposure, controlled network-evolution, and joint controlled contrasts rather than a mediation decomposition. We develop the Dynamic Network Doubly Robust estimator, DynaNet-DR, which combines a temporally factorized propensity with normalized augmentation. Under consistency, summary sufficiency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, nuisance convergence, and weak dependence, its canonical estimator is consistent when either the outcome regression or the propensity estimator is consistent. translated_title: 当干扰图演化时：动态同伴效应的双重稳健估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27187v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当交互图演化时，同伴效应难以估计，因为预分配网络历史、动态同伴暴露和后分配网络变化具有不同的因果作用。我们引入了一个受控对比框架，该框架通过自身处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和后分配演化摘要来索引潜在结果。所得均值之间的差异定义了自身处理、同伴暴露、受控网络演化和联合受控对比，而非中介分解。我们开发了动态网络双重稳健估计器 DynaNet-DR，它结合了时间因子化的倾向得分与归一化增强。在一致性、摘要充分性、顺序可交换性、正性、干扰收敛和弱依赖性条件下，当结果回归或倾向估计器之一一致时，其典型估计器是一致的。所报告的实现……
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的因果框架和双重稳健估计器，用于在动态演化的交互网络中准确估计同伴效应，解决了网络历史、动态暴露和网络变化因果角色混淆的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel causal framework and doubly robust estimator for accurately estimating peer effects in dynamically evolving interaction networks, addressing the confounding causal roles of network history, dynamic exposure, and network changes.
